abstract: Testicular neoplasms are comprised of a variety of histologically different forms, and their pathogenesis has not been elucidated. Dysadherin is a recently described cell membrane glycoprotein, which has an anticell-cell adhesion function and downregulates E-cadherin. In this study, we examined immunohistochemically the expression of E-cadherin and dysadherin in 120 testicular neoplasms (37 seminomas-26 classic, five spermatocytic and six anaplastic-, 45 embryonal carcinomas, 10 mixed germ cell tumours, two yolk sac tumours, 10 mature and eight immature teratomas and eight non-Hodgkin B-cell lymphomas), clinical stage I. The intensity, the expression pattern and the percentage of neoplastic cell staining was recorded and correlated with the histologic type and vascular/lymphatic invasion. Dysadherin was not expressed in non-neoplastic germ cells, neither in CIS/ITGCNU, but it was highly expressed in all types of germ cell tumours, that demonstrated either embryonic phenotype or somatic differentiation, in most terminally differentiated neoplasms, and in all lymphomas. Dysadherin expression did not correlate with vascular invasion. Increased dysadherin expression was correlated with aberrant E-cadherin expression in most tumours. In 17% of embryonal carcinomas colocalisation of dysadherin and membranous E-cadherin staining was noted. This is the first report on dysadherin expression and its association with E-cadherin in testicular tumours. Since dysadherin is not normally expressed in non-neoplastic testis, it is conceivable that it plays a role in the neoplastic transformation of germ cells. In testicular tumours, as in other neoplasms, dysadherin downregulates E-cadherin expression, at least in part.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍は多様な組織型からなり、その発症機序は解明されていない。Dysadherinは最近記載された細胞膜糖タンパク質で、細胞間接着を阻害し、E-cadherinをダウンレギュレートする作用を持つ。本研究では、臨床病期Iの精巣腫瘍120例（セミノーマ37例〔古典型26例、精母細胞性5例、未分化6例〕、胎児性癌45例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍10例、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例、成熟奇形腫10例、未熟奇形腫8例、非ホジキンB細胞リンパ腫8例）におけるE-cadherinおよびdysadherinの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。染色強度、発現パターン、腫瘍細胞の染色割合を記録し、組織型および血管・リンパ管侵襲と相関させた。Dysadherinは非腫瘍性の胚細胞、およびCIS/ITGCNUでは発現しなかったが、胚性表現型または体細胞分化を示すすべての型の胚細胞腫瘍、ほとんどの終末分化した腫瘍、およびすべてのリンパ腫で高発現していた。Dysadherinの発現は血管侵襲とは相関しなかった。ほとんどの腫瘍で、dysadherinの発現亢進はE-cadherinの異常発現と相関していた。胎児性癌の17%では、dysadherinと膜型E-cadherin染色の共局在が認められた。これは精巣腫瘍におけるdysadherin発現およびE-cadherinとの関連に関する初めての報告である。Dysadherinは正常な精巣では発現していないため、胚細胞の腫瘍化に関与している可能性が考えられる。精巣腫瘍においても、他の腫瘍と同様に、dysadherinはE-cadherinの発現を少なくとも部分的にダウンレギュレートしている。
